title: AppLovin reports Q3 revenue up 68% YoY to $1.41B, vs. $1.34B est., and forecasts Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA above estimates; APP jumps 6%+ after hours (Luke Kawa/Sherwood News)
summary: Luke Kawa /Sherwood News:AppLovin reports Q3 revenue up 68% YoY to $1.41B, vs. $1.34B est., and forecasts Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA above estimates; APP jumps 6%+ after hours—  AppLovin rose after the adtech company reported top- and bottom-line results that modestly exceeded expectations …
